## MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the Current Market Regime?**
RISK-ON: Low volatility 19.2% and broad participation (Breadth 5/8), risk appetite intact with cyclical leadership.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Energy & Chemicals ABOVE TREND: TUPRS (1W: +14.23% | 1M: +25.98%) ABOVE TREND, GUBRF (1W: +10.57% | 1M: +7.55%) ABOVE TREND; Retail & Food ABOVE TREND: SOKM (1W: +9.29% | 1M: +2.67%) ABOVE TREND, BIMAS (1W: +9.16% | 1M: +2.81%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Technology & Telecom BELOW TREND: TTKOM (1W: -2.00% | 1M: -8.18%) BELOW TREND; Banking & Finance MIX/WEAK: YKBNK (1W: -2.08% | 1M: +5.01%) CORRECTION, VAKBN (1W: -3.22% | 1M: -1.89%) BELOW TREND; Transportation BELOW TREND: THYAO (1W: -2.19% | 1M: -6.15%) BELOW TREND.

## STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
TUPRS (1W: +14.23% | 1M: +25.98%) ABOVE TREND, GUBRF (1W: +10.57% | 1M: +7.55%) ABOVE TREND, PETKM (1W: +9.62% | 1M: -7.20%) RECOVERY, SOKM (1W: +9.29% | 1M: +2.67%) ABOVE TREND, BIMAS (1W: +9.16% | 1M: +2.81%) ABOVE TREND.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
TTKOM (1W: -2.00% | 1M: -8.18%) BELOW TREND, YKBNK (1W: -2.08% | 1M: +5.01%) CORRECTION, VESTL (1W: -2.12% | 1M: -10.06%) BELOW TREND, THYAO (1W: -2.19% | 1M: -6.15%) BELOW TREND, ARCLK (1W: -2.32% | 1M: -6.19%) BELOW TREND.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Top 1W movers: TUPRS (1W: +14.23% | 1M: +25.98%) ABOVE TREND, GUBRF (1W: +10.57% | 1M: +7.55%) ABOVE TREND, PETKM (1W: +9.62% | 1M: -7.20%) RECOVERY, SOKM (1W: +9.29% | 1M: +2.67%) ABOVE TREND, BIMAS (1W: +9.16% | 1M: +2.81%) ABOVE TREND.

## SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Banking Sector Outlook?**
Neutral-to-cautious: AKBNK (1W: +0.22% | 1M: +3.98%) ABOVE TREND, GARAN (1W: -0.23% | 1M: +2.70%) CORRECTION, ISCTR (1W: -1.04% | 1M: -5.21%) BELOW TREND — prefer selective exposure to banks showing clear 1M confirmation.

**8. Industrial Sector Outlook?**
Mixed industrials: KRDMD (1W: +7.76% | 1M: +7.24%) ABOVE TREND, ASELS (1W: +1.64% | 1M: +8.72%) ABOVE TREND, EREGL (1W: -0.37% | 1M: -9.80%) BELOW TREND, TOASO (1W: +0.46% | 1M: -8.91%) RECOVERY — favor earnings-confirmed cyclicals.

**9. Energy & Chemicals Outlook?**
Energy leadership but bifurcated: TUPRS (1W: +14.23% | 1M: +25.98%) ABOVE TREND, TRALT (1W: +6.96% | 1M: +3.23%) ABOVE TREND, PETKM (1W: +9.62% | 1M: -7.20%) RECOVERY vs SASA (1W: -7.35% | 1M: -14.02%) BELOW TREND and SISE (1W: -3.94% | 1M: -8.30%) BELOW TREND.

## PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Risk-on stance: overweight Energy & Chemicals and selective Retail/Heavy Industry (TUPRS, KCHOL, BIMAS, KRDMD), trim Technology and weak Transportation/bank names; maintain stop discipline on momentum names given stretched 1M gains.

## NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
TUPRS (1W: +14.23% | 1M: +25.98%) ABOVE TREND, KCHOL (1W: +7.71% | 1M: +6.71%) ABOVE TREND, PETKM (1W: +9.62% | 1M: -7.20%) RECOVERY, BIMAS (1W: +9.16% | 1M: +2.81%) ABOVE TREND — watch earnings/operational updates and oil/commodity flows.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
Energy & Chemicals and Retail & Food for continuation, Banking for headline sensitivity (CBRT/FX) and Technology for downside risk.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
Watch XU100's ability to hold recent breakout and the 20-day MA as immediate support; upside confirmed on a sustained break above the recent swing high. Primary triggers: oil price moves, TRY moves and CBRT commentary, upcoming company earnings (TUPRS, KCHOL, PETKM).

## EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

Low volatility RISK-ON market with cyclical leadership centered on Energy and Retail; momentum concentrated in TUPRS, GUBRF and retail names. Main risk is a reversal in commodity/FX drivers and underperformance in Technology/Transportation, so stay overweight cyclicals but keep stops and monitor macro triggers.
